canonical_queue.binding_basis: The rendered titles match TP C01-C06 exactly; C05 and C06 are bound by title rather than upload order. The TZ01 title sequence is different.

audit_policy.semantic_track: Check whether wording, numbers, visual data encodings and causal structure remain faithful to the source and card-specific constraints.
audit_policy.strict_render_track: Treat card.title, card.visible_text, allowed_visible_numbers and the exact-once citation as the complete visible render contract; scene descriptions authorise objects, not extra labels or demonstrative numbers.
global_constraints_checked: no best-shoe prescription from a scoping review
no universal AFT or carbon-plate advantage
no conversion of acute biomechanical proxies into proven injury prevention or long-term performance
no causal reading of observational injury and blister associations
no claim that different wearable devices are numerically interchangeable

summary.interpretation: Five cards are source-aligned in meaning. C05 adds precise watch readings 158 and 142 that neither the canonical queue nor the paper authorises. Every card also contains unlisted scene text under the queue's exact visible-text contract.

cards.title: 越野鞋研究，證據其實很偏
visible_text: 生物力學 10 篇（62%）最多；舒適 5 篇（31%）
生理、表現、傷害各 4 篇（25%）
研究數量只代表研究焦點，不代表鞋款效果大小。
標籤與框線表示內容功能；小標記表示證據狀態。
cards.main_visual_scene: A branching evidence map separates trail running and hiking, then distributes outcome-domain counts around a trail shoe and mountain setting.

violations: Unlisted visible labels split the authorised sentences into repeated branch labels such as 越野跑, 健行, 生物力學, 生理, 表現, 傷害 and 舒適.
The evidence-state legend adds 核心, 推論, 缺口 and 衝突 text beyond the exact visible_text list.

cards.title: 越野「超級鞋」沒有一致優勢
visible_text: 14 人男性研究：AFT 泡棉氧耗 −1.2%
10 人男性研究：碳板原型上坡代謝耗能 +2%
12 人男性模擬山徑賽：整體時間沒有改善
鞋款、坡度與測法都不同；不能把單一研究改寫成「一定更快」。
cards.main_visual_scene: Three parallel small-study panels show lower oxygen use, higher uphill metabolic cost and no overall time improvement without collapsing them into one direction.

violations: Unlisted scene labels and symbols include O₂, UP and FINISH; the directional glyphs are separate visual data encodings not listed as text.

cards.title: 鞋子會改變動作，但不是單一路徑
visible_text: 碳板：上坡小腿衝擊指標下降；下坡與足底壓力沒有顯著差異
鞋面包覆、鞋底剛性、極簡設計與緩震，改變的是不同指標
穿戴感測器讓山徑量測更真實，但不同裝置不一定可直接互換
急性生物力學代理指標 ≠ 已證實的防傷或長期表現。
cards.main_visual_scene: Uphill and downhill runners with shoe and leg sensors are connected to separate attribute and proxy-outcome callouts.

violations: Unlisted scene labels include 上坡, 下坡, 小腿 IMU, 鞋內 IMU, 足底壓力 and the three lower construction callout headings.

cards.title: 越野鞋不是「防傷盾牌」
visible_text: 大型越野跑調查：39.8% 回報過傷害，但鞋型與傷害發生沒有顯著關聯
健行者臨床觀察：74% 有水泡，鞋型仍沒有顯著關聯
富士山問卷：健行鞋／登山靴與較低跌倒勝算相關（OR 0.812）
背包重量、地形、濕襪等因素也會一起影響結果
全部都不是隨機鞋款試驗；關聯不能畫成因果。
cards.main_visual_scene: Observational footwear findings are connected with uncertain lines to injury, blister and fall outcomes, while confounders remain visible.

violations: Unlisted outcome labels 傷害事件, 水泡 and 跌倒事件 are rendered separately from the authorised sentences.

cards.title: 方法進步了，證據底盤還很薄
visible_text: 實驗研究平均樣本 13 ± 7 人
6 篇研究只納入男性
穿戴感測器能帶進真實山徑，但不同裝置可有系統性偏差
本綜述沒有做正式 critical appraisal
「有研究」不等於「證據很確定」。
cards.main_visual_scene: Laboratory and real-trail measurement settings are contrasted, with two different wearable devices shown as not perfectly aligned and a visibly thin evidence foundation.
cards.targeted_audit: fail: the watches render precise values 158 and 142 that are absent from visible_text, allowed_visible_numbers and the paper.
semantic_violations: The values 158 and 142 are fabricated demonstrative heart-rate readings.
Their realistic measurement format can be mistaken for original study data even though the paper only describes systematic device bias without those numbers.
cards.required_correction: Remove 158 and 142. Depict non-alignment without numeric readings, or formally revise the specification with clearly labelled fictional values that cannot be confused with source data.

violations: Unlisted and unauthorised visible numbers: 158 and 142.
Unlisted visible label: 讀值不完全對齊.

cards.title: 最大缺口：長時間 × 疲勞
visible_text: 多數研究只看急性反應
跑者疲勞與鞋材老化常被混在一起，長期效應還不清楚
女性與真實長距離山徑情境仍需要更多資料
個人化、證據導向選鞋目前仍是研究方向，不是可直接套用的處方。
cards.main_visual_scene: A long-duration axis carries runner fatigue and shoe-material ageing toward an unresolved long-trail region and a future research box.

violations: Unlisted scene labels include 短時間／清楚, 測試時間增加, 長距離山徑／還不清楚, 跑者疲勞, 鞋材壓縮老化 and the research-direction box heading.
